run_moses_tokenizer_cli: run a CLI tool that tokenizes stdin text using sacremoses MosesTokenizer with configurable language
run_tokenizer_with_language: run the tokenizer with a specific language like Spanish using the --lang flag
run_tokenizer_preserve_tabs: run the tokenizer on tab-separated input and preserve tab delimiters in output
review_main_function: review the main function that creates a MosesTokenizer and tokenizes each line from stdin
refactor_tok_inner_function: refactor the inner tok function to support additional tokenization options beyond return_str
